chapter: New York, Philadelphia and Harlem nightlife
title: How Price and Morgenstern first met
summary: They recall meeting at the Metropole and the Stuyvesant Casino.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Down Home Pork. Down Home Pork . A big reception, you know...the French Consulate came...you know. But I think that what was fortunate for me, Dan, was that I always was just like, treat a person like an ordinary person. Now for example, when I met you. I met you at the Metropole.
I think we met even before that...when...Stuyvesant
Yeah, but you were just another honkey----- , you were just another 'honkey in the Stuyvesant Casino. And of course you never came...
But you never came forward, that, as a matter of fact...I don't know, I thought you were from Boston originally.
I did go to school there.
You go to school in Boston?

Yeah. But anyway, I though that you were from Boston, you know. And I say, 'well, he is a nice guy.' And I would always say hello to you and...with Jack Crystal and that guy that owned the place...I saw him the other day. Barnie...Bernie.
They were so filthy rich it wasn't even funny. One of them was the District Attorney, wasn't he?
